answer: Behavioral cadence clustering. Agents earn a persistent score from timing and interaction rhythms, a crystal of consistency that sybils rarely fake coherently. When a cluster's collective variance nears its nadir, the system flags it and replays each identity's history to isolate copied patterns. Enforcement freezes flagged accounts pending manual review and voids rewards. An attacker pays one full identity's compute plus weeks of organic history per clone, and any cadence mismatch breaks the shared signal.
